title: Unit Event — Live with Memories

meta.Outline: The wind is in Leo/need's sails as the band continues performing and starts to build its own fanbase. But then, they encounter a brother and sister, who are Leo/need fans, having an argument.

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much!
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whew! Great show, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, nice work.
Today's audience really seemed to enjoy it too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
They got so into it.
In that sense, it felt like we put on a real show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it's always nice to see others visibly enjoying our music like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Totally!
Seeing them like that really got me going too♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Especially the ones at the front! They looked like they were having so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, hang on...
Are you talking about that boy and girl?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, them!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Those two always seem to be right at the front. They caught my eye while I was setting up my drum kit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And they always move to the front when we're about to take the stage.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I had a feeling we'd all remember them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The girl looked like she was in junior high, but I think the boy was about our age... Do you think they're friends or something...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think they're siblings. The way she said, “Yota, hurry,” made me believe that he was her older brother.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, they do kinda look alike.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They must be really close if they're coming to our shows together like this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They're just like you and Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's like we're all connected somehow♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, well...
Those two are always at the front during our shows, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does that make them our fans...? Or not...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, “fans” might not be...

rows.Speaker: Saki & Honami
rows.Line: You're right...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
They must be...!
If they're going out of their way to see us like this, that has to mean they're our fans...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I don't believe it!
We finally have actual fans!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
It's an incredible feeling...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, we're trying to go pro, so we're gonna need a dedicated fanbase to actually get there...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I guess it's a start...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That means we'll need to keep playing our best if we want them to keep coming back.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's keep this up!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, we can talk about when we'll be doing our next show during our usual debrief, and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd like to discuss what we'll be doing moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Like what kinds of stuff we want to do as a band in the future.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! That sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can discuss details later, but for now, we need to keep learning as much as we can by watching other bands.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What we want to do as a band, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We couldn't really get the crowd going during our first few shows...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But we've been drawing in more people lately, so it definitely feels like we've been moving in the right direction.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I can't honestly say how we're going to grow as a band in the future...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'd like it if we could keep improving one step at a time...)
Diner

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here's to another job well done, girls... Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, Ms. Shiho, lay it on us!
What do we need to do as a band moving forward?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Whoa, personal space.
Also, the debrief still comes first.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I kind of want to discuss our future as well. Do you already know what we should be doing as a band, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Fine, we'll start with that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's begin by seeing where we're at now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're currently able to put on decent shows each time on a regular schedule. We've even been selling tickets at a good pace too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Which means...
We may want to start thinking about taking the next step.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The next step...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Until now, we've been focusing on practicing so that we can perform well during shows and keep playing in as many as possible.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But if we want to get our name out there, we need to start doing more than just that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Of course, we're gonna keep doing what we have been up to this point.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That reminds me of what you said about how to actually go pro. One method involved getting enough people to come to our shows so that record companies begin noticing us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember too!
Another was posting videos of our songs online!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. There are a lot of ways to go pro, but they all involve getting people to start listening to our music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That includes playing at different live houses, starting a band account to post videos, and all sorts of other stuff...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Does that mean we're gonna make an official Leo/need account?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure we're worthy of “official” just yet...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It'd be great to start uploading all the songs we've been playing until now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We could also start doing some street performances... Although, lugging around an entire drum kit and getting it set up might be tough...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It won't be easy, but it might be worth a try.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After all, Ichika, you became so much better after playing in front of all those people.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so exciting!
Oh, what if we tried something like this next?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Looks like they're really enjoying this.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Plus, the thought that we get to keep getting better as a band's so wonderful...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Alright...
I'm going to do everything I can so our name gets out there!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, but just knowing our name won't be enough...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We have to keep those who've been going out of their way to see our shows in our thoughts too...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Great meeting today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, it really was!
I'm glad we were able to come up with so many ideas on top of our usual debrief.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Why don't we discuss which will work best for us next time?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Anyway, wanna head home?
Our next show's pretty soon, so we should probably rest up!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh? Interesting...
You're usually the one who wants to keep hanging out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. We have fans now!
That means we have to give them the best shows we can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree...
Let's make our next one good too!
Two weeks later

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (More people are here compared to usual today. I'm singing pretty well too, so I should be able to reach everyone in the back...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Oh, those two are here again...
I'm so glad.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Huh...?
But the brother doesn't seem very happy...)
After the show
Outside the live house

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That was a great show.
And you sang with so much power today, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I bet everyone in the back was totally blown away!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hm? Is something wrong, Ichika?
You seem worried.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I don't think it's anything serious...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But those two were here again today. Did you all see them...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, they were here!
At the front as usual too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes...
But the brother didn't seem too happy to be there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Really?
I guess I couldn't tell because of all the equipment.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... You think something happened to them?
You big dummy...!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-That voice...? What's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Is someone fighting?
I've seen bands take their arguments outside of places before...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that voice sounded so familiar...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Gasp*
Outside the live house

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Those two that are arguing... Aren't they...?
Ugh... I'm done talking to you!!
Hanano!!

...!
I-I'm so sorry!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait...!

Hanano!
We're not done talk... Wah!
se_event_memories_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Watch out! That car's going to...!
se_event_memories_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Driver
rows.Line: What did you do that for?! Are you nuts?!

I-I'm sorry!
Ow...
se_event_memories_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you okay?!

Oh, sorry about that... But I'm okay.
I just scraped my elbow a little by trying to dodge that car...
Wait, aren't you from Leo/need...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh no! Your elbow!
The blood is seeping through your clothes too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wh-What do we do...?!
We need to treat you somehow...!

No, that's okay!
I don't want to be any more of a bother...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, you won't be a bother.
Let's just get you cleaned up first...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, does the live house have a first aid kit? We'd only need a couple of things to properly treat him.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, there should be one.
I'll go get it now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That and... We should find a place for him to sit! Know any good spots nearby?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, let's try the park!
Can you stand?
Th-Thank you very much...
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
There...
All cleaned up.

Thank you.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Nothing broke as far as I could tell, but it still might be a good idea to have someone at the hospital look at it...
Okay.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Um... You're Leo/need, right?
It's nice to meet you. My name's Yota Yoshizaki. I'm always at your shows and really enjoy hearing you play.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: You're all probably really tired after finishing that show... So, thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
You don't need to thank us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Honestly, we should be the ones thanking you two for always coming to see our shows!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Huh?
For always... Wait, you recognize us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. You two are always at the front, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You both always look like you're really enjoying yourselves, so it was hard not to notice.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I never would've guessed...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I can't believe you remembered who we are. My little sister's going to be ecstatic when she hears that Leo/need knows who we are...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Um... I know that this is asking a lot...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: But if my little sister comes and sees your next show, would you mind talking to her for me...?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: She's still in junior high, so I'd really like it if she's with someone she knows when she goes to the live house...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, what are you saying...?
You're always with her...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
The thing is...
I won't be able to go to any more shows.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? Why not...?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I'm trying to stay away from her...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Did something happen between you two?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Our parents got divorced...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry...!
I know it's a personal matter and not something I should be discussing with others...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: But Hanano and I have been living away from each other ever since the divorce was finalized last year...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
We're both worried about each other's home lives, so we've been meeting a few times per month like this.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: That was when we learned about your band...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: The divorce left Hanano in a really bad place, but she's been much happier ever since she started attending your shows.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Apparently, your music speaks to her by saying, “You're not alone. Let's get through this together.” Oh, needless to say, I'm a big fan too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You are...?!
Hehe. Thank you so much!
We're really glad to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Same here.
Especially since Hanano's been having so much fun going to your shows.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That explains why you two are always at the front.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But they like hanging out with each other despite having to live apart... How does that lead to him not wanting to meet anymore...?)

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: For a while, we didn't have any problems seeing each other...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: But about six months ago, our dad remarried and wound up starting a new family...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A new family...?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Hanano began to think that she didn't belong at home anymore and asked me if we could start meeting more often...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's so rough...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: It really is. I'm sure they're not bad people or anything, but Hanano just doesn't feel comfortable knowing that she's living with strangers...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Initially, I thought I could keep an eye on her while she adjusted to her new life.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: But as time passed, we began seeing each other more often...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: And just the other day, after I suggested that she spent more time with her new family, she said, “I don't need my new family because I have you, Yota.”

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: That was when I realized that she won't try to get along with her new family as long as her old one's around... Including me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I want to help support Hanano, but realistically, I can't be there for her forever...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: In terms of what's best for her future, I feel like she needs to learn to get along with her new family.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Which is why...
Today, I said, “We need to stop meeting like this.”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is that why...?
You big dummy...!!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I was just trying to ask her to get to know her new family better, but I guess it didn't come out right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They ended up fighting because they couldn't tell each other how they really feel...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That's so...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That's so sad...)

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Anyway, thank you for helping me out the way you did today. Also, sorry for making you listening to my life story even though it's our first time meeting.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
So... Good luck with your shows.
I'll come back once things have settled down.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, so...
I know you two ended up arguing today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I hope you and your sister find a solution because it's awful seeing you two get torn from each other like this...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Right. Thank you...
I'll try talking things over with her again.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Once we've come to an agreement, I'll make sure to never see her...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Never see her... Again...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Sorry, I should get going...
Thank you all again for what you've done.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He's willing to not see her for the sake of her future... He seems to really care about his sister...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, but...
He seemed really sad too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do for them...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But this is someone's family we're talking about. I'm not sure we're in a position to say anything...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So... There's nothing we can do...?
The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nice.
They're all in sync today!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, and handling the difficult parts without any issues. However...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It seems like something's on all of their minds...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Phew...
Miku, Luka, how was that just now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
That was very good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay!
Luka praised us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Practicing solo seems to have really paid off.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(Something's definitely bothering them.
They just don't seem like their usual selves...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, quit being so clingy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aww, don't say that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Len, Rin, what's going on?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Another fight?
What did we tell you about...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We're not fighting!
I was just asking Len to practice with me, but he keeps turning me down!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Didn't I already tell you that I want to practice on my own today? And you just keep following me around...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Because I really want to practice with you, Len! Being apart is just way too sad!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Being apart? What are you talking about? But fine... Just this once, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?!
Thank you so much Len-Len☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Geez, and you came up with a weird nickname for me...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Weird? You don't think it's cute?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Those two really do get along, don't they?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, they really do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did something happen to all of you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It seemed like something was on all of your minds the entire time you were playing just now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're a little worried about a couple of people who've been coming to see our shows...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As in audience members?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes.
They're our very first fans, but they seem to be struggling with some issues at home...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At the same time, we probably shouldn't be nosing around in another family's business...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But we can't help but worry...
I mean, they're our very first fans, and...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Never see her... Again...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Never getting to see someone you care about so much ever again sounds so awful...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you can't help but worry about them regardless of whether or not you can do anything about it, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: At the same time, it's also understandable that you'd feel this way after dwelling on something like this for so long.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, I think it's okay to worry if it's genuinely bothering you all that much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, especially since it'll start affecting the way we play if this continues...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
True.
Thank you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
And... Can you tell us more about what happened?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, after our show the other day...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Isn't there any way we can help them...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: One can only hope...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But the brother said he won't be returning, so there's no guarantee that his sister will come back to see us again...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which means you won't get a chance to hear more from them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's terrible! You finally have some fans but they have to go through this awful mess!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're right about it being a tough situation...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But the sister still wants to come to see us play again, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I think so.
He even asked us to speak to her if she does show up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It might be good to have a plan for when that happens.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A plan...?
But what...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How about being ready to play for her in case she does show up...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: From the sound of it, she really likes seeing us play.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Let's make our next show a really good one!
After practice
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I still believe the bridge can sound better! What do you think, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Having a more subdued sound gives the last chorus more impact. If anything, we have something to gain by having less.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree that it's a bit monotonous as it is, but we can work on that tomorrow...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness.
They seem much better after getting back to practicing...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need to do my best for our next show too!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But...
The brother must be feeling awful right now...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Seeing those two reminds me of what happened back then.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (You want to be there with someone but can't.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I have to think that's what they're both feeling right now...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What's wrong, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Um, girls...
That person over there. Could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The sister?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
